**Proposed mechanism:** GCNT2 (HGNC:4204) —DISRUPTS→ N-glycan branching (GO:0009114); N-glycan branching (GO:0009114) —LEADS_TO→ Cataract (HP:0000119); N-glycan branching (GO:0009114) —LEADS_TO→ ABO blood group system (MONDO:0044220).
